question: What is the holding cost and setup cost in DC-14 lot sizing?
answer: DC-14 plans 12 SKUs over 8 weeks. [1] Holding cost is 1.20 per unit-week. [2] Setup cost is 450 per changeover. [3] Four setups beat weekly changeovers because the 450 setup dwarfs 1.20 holding. [4]

question: How should Pyomo represent SKU-NH442 lot sizing at DC-14?
answer:
from pyomo.environ import *
model = ConcreteModel('DC14_LotSizing')
model.T = RangeSet(1, 8)
model.P = Set(initialize=['SKU-NH442'])
model.hold = Param(initialize=1.20)
model.setup = Param(initialize=450)
model.y = Var(model.P, model.T, domain=Binary) [1] SKU-NH442 should be built in week 2 and week 3 only. [2] Week-3 demand spike is 1800 units of SKU-NH442. [3] DC-14 plans 12 SKUs over 8 weeks. [4]

question: What is the capex budget and conflict in the project knapsack?
answer:
Select a subset of 12 plant projects under a shared capex budget of 2.4 million. [1] A 100k budget increase would add Project Iota, not Delta. [2] model = ConcreteModel('CapexKnapsack')
model.I = RangeSet(1, 12)
model.z = Var(model.I, domain=Binary)
model.budget = Param(initialize=2400000)
model.conflict = Constraint(expr=model.z[3] + model.z[4] <= 1) [3] Project Gamma cannot be chosen with Project Delta (mutual exclusion). [4]
